reason: Method relies on intraday relative strength/weakness to SPY, algo lines, and real-time breaks that cannot be approximated on daily bars.
style: day trading with relative strength to SPY

universe.description: US stocks, focus on those with relative strength/weakness to SPY regardless of index membership

setup.rule: Scan for stocks with proportional strength or weakness to SPY
setup.quote: if you start looking for stocks that have proportional strength or weakness against the market it's sort of like having that wind at your back

setup.rule: Identify breaks of 200-day MA or descending trend line with relative strength
setup.quote: AMD started becoming relatively strong to the market proportionally strong to spy it breaks through its 200-day moving average it breaks through its downward uh descending uh trend line

entry.rule: Enter long on break of resistance layers when stock has relative strength and market above 50 SMA
entry.quote: now I have a stop that I can go long using the stock or options and when I use options I use deep in the money options

stop.rule: Mental stops based on chart thesis invalidation, no preset stop losses
stop.quote: I use Mental stops but I like to stay um I like to stay flexible in my trades

exits.rule: Exit when chart or thesis is no longer valid, add to winners rather than take quick profits
exits.quote: you should get out of the stock when the chart or the thesis that you have is no longer valid

sizing.rule: Position size based on comfort with mental stop levels, scale base up 15% every six months
sizing.quote: every six months I increase my base by 15

market_filter.rule: Market bullish when closes above 50 SMA; trade only high-probability setups aligned with SPY direction
market_filter.quote: the market closed above the 50 SMA today so I have a market in a bullish uptrend

ambiguities.issue: Mentions options but primary method appears stock-based intraday
ambiguities.assumption: Focus remains intraday equity trading with occasional deep ITM options
